name: Uniroyal Marine Exports Limited
about: Uniroyal Marine Exports Limited engages in manufacturing, processing, curing, canning, freezing, purchasing, selling, exporting, and dealing in marine products in India. It offers shrimps, squids, cuttlefish, octapus, and seafood mix. The company also exports its products. Uniroyal Marine Exports Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Calicut, India.
